This file provides guidance to Coding Agent when working with code in this repository.

## What is PegaInfer

Pure Rust + CUDA LLM inference engine. No PyTorch, no frameworks. OpenAI-compatible `/v1/completions` API.

**Supported models:**

Every model line is behind a cargo feature; only `qwen3` is a default feature, so the stock build is pure Rust + CUDA with no Python.

| Model | Crate | Feature flag | Architecture |
|-------|-------|-------------|-------------|
| Qwen3-4B / 8B | `pegainfer-qwen3` | `qwen3` (default) | Full attention, TP support |
| Qwen3.5-4B / 9B / 27B · Qwen3.8-27B | `pegainfer-qwen35` | `--features qwen35` (needs build-time Python + Triton) | Hybrid Gated DeltaNet + full attention. Qwen3.8 shares the line: same `model_type`, same text geometry — see `docs/models/qwen35/support-qwen38.md` |
| DeepSeek-V2-Lite | `pegainfer-deepseek-v2-lite` | `--features deepseek-v2-lite` | MoE + EP, 2-GPU |
| Gemma 4 | `pegainfer-gemma4` | `--features gemma4` | Sliding-window + global full attention, dense sizes at TP2 (one rank per device), batched decode, opt-in chunked prefill (single rank only) |
| Kimi-K2 | `pegainfer-kimi-k2` | `--features kimi-k2` | MLA + MoE + Marlin INT4, 8-GPU EP |
| GLM5.2 | `pegainfer-glm52` | `--features glm52` | MLA + MoE + FP8, 8-GPU EP (bring-up) |
| Kimi-K3 | `pegainfer-k3` | `--features k3` | Hybrid KDA + MLA, latent MoE + MXFP4, EP (bring-up — single-rank decode wired) |

## Build & Run

**Always use `--release`** — debug builds are extremely slow for GPU/CUDA and will timeout.

When developing with Docker, use `docker/Dockerfile.dev` and `docker/dev.sh` as described in `docker/README.md`.

```bash
# Qwen3 (default feature, no Python anywhere in the build)
cargo run --release -- --model-path models/Qwen3-4B

# Feature-gated models
cargo run --release --features qwen35 -- --model-path models/Qwen3.5-4B
cargo run --release --features kimi-k2 -- --model-path models/Kimi-K2
cargo run --release --features deepseek-v2-lite -- --model-path models/DeepSeek-V2-Lite
cargo run --release --features glm52 -- --model-path models/GLM5.2
```

**Key env vars:**
- `PEGAINFER_CUDA_SM` — GPU SM target override when `nvidia-smi` unavailable (e.g. `120` or `120,80`)
- `PEGAINFER_TRITON_PYTHON` — Python with Triton for `qwen35` build-time AOT kernel generation (falls back to `.venv/bin/python`, then `python3`, then `python`)
- `PEGAINFER_TILELANG_PYTHON` — Python with TileLang for the `glm52` sparse-MLA build-time AOT (sm_90a targets only)
- `PEGAINFER_NCCL_ROOT` — NCCL root (>= 2.30.4) for DeepEP shim (`moe` feature)
- `PEGAINFER_FLASHINFER_INCLUDE` — FlashInfer include dir override
- `PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH` — override test model path (default: `models/Qwen3-4B`)
- `PEGAINFER_BUILD_TIMING=1` — print per-phase build timings (nvcc, Triton AOT, etc.)
- `PEGAINFER_NVCC_JOBS` — override parallel nvcc job count
- `PEGAINFER_GEMM_LT_CACHE` — opt-in cross-process cublasLt algo store: `<file>` carries the winners `gemm_lt_tune` timed in an earlier boot instead of re-timing them (Qwen3-4B on one sm_89 card: warm ready ~1965 → ~1312 ms, paired 5/5). Append-only text, created if absent, safe to share between processes and machines and safe to delete; each record carries GPU, CUDA runtime/driver/cublasLt version, shape and workspace cap, so anything that does not match is a miss and re-tunes (a driver update that keeps the same CUDA level is not distinguished — delete the file to force a re-tune). Unset = tune on every boot; Qwen3's `--batch-invariant` pins the heuristic instead and never reads it
- `PEGAINFER_GLOBAL_ATTN` — gemma4 global-attention kernel and pool format: unset/`off` = the incumbent kernel on the split K|V pool (byte-identical serving); `tilelang` = the generated kernel on the same pool; `tilelang640` = the generated kernel on a folded pool whose rows hold K only where the rotation touches it and fold K's norm weight into the query, 640 columns per token per head instead of 1024. Both generated states also read the sliding family's prompt rows through a generated windowed prefill and its pure-decode rows through a generated windowed split-KV kernel, project Q|K|V and gate|up with one GEMM each where the split state issues one per projection (the fused shape may round differently), need a build that carries the kernels, and report the global pool's bytes at start-up
- `PEGAINFER_KV_FP8` — gemma4 opt-in fp8 KV: `local` stores the sliding family's K/V as e4m3 at scale 1.0 (lossy; halves the local pool; refuses an enabled prefix cache; unset = byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_PREFIX_CACHE` — gemma4 opt-in conversation prefix cache: `K` entries of captured prompt state resume multi-turn prompts (pre-allocated page budget; unset = off, byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_ADMIT_COALESCE_MS` — gemma4 opt-in admission coalesce door: `N` ms in `1..=2000` (`off`/`0`/unset = admit on sight), holds arrivals that would invade a live decode batch so a window's arrivals land as one admission burst; refuses the async prefill lane; merging into one mixed step needs the chunked walk or a sub-budget prompt
- `PEGAINFER_ASYNC_PREFILL` — gemma4 opt-in overlap lane: `green:NN` prefills live-batch admissions on an SM-capped stream to protect decode tails (`shared` for comparison; unset = off; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` — gemma4 opt-in chunked walk: a mixed admission computes at most `N` prompt rows per step (`64 <= N <` the serving ceiling; unset = whole-prompt steps; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_GATHER_ROWS` / `PEGAINFER_MIX_MAX_PROMPTS` — gemma4 admission gather: how many prompt rows and how many prompts one mixed step may absorb (`1..=` the serving ceiling and `1..=` the decode slots; defaults gather only short bursts). Raising them lets a burst ride one step, which trades the median time to first token for the p99 tail and the wide-batch decode step; bad values refuse to start
- `PEGAINFER_MAX_CONTEXT` — gemma4 serving ceiling raise (default 8192, up to the checkpoint's 262144; a raise past the default needs `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` and refuses the async lane)
- `PEGAINFER_DECODE_SLOTS` — gemma4 decode slots (1..16, default 16): global KV budget = slots x ceiling, trade concurrency for context
- `GLM52_DECODE_SLOTS` / `GLM52_MTP_DRAFTS` — glm52 runtime profile: decode slots per rank (default 8, ceiling 32) and MTP draft span (default 5); `slots x (1+drafts)` must fit the 96-row step (validated at launch; MTP only). Throughput ceiling profile: `32` / `2`.
- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP` — k3 opt-in context-parallel prefill lane: CP width, must equal the process's local rank count (on a fleet each process runs its own gang; remote ranks pad). Mutually exclusive with the dspark draft lane.
- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP_MIN` — k3 CP admission floor in prompt tokens (default 2048; measured crossover ~1k). Prompts below it, or too long for one chunk step per rank (M0), prefill locally.

## Tests

```bash
# Unit tests (~9s)
cargo test --release --workspace --lib

# Lines gated on their own kernel feature need it named to run their unit tests.
# The K3 command also names the kernels crate, whose K3 tests ride the same
# feature:
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-k3 -p pegainfer-kernels --features k3 --lib
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-glm52 --features glm52 --lib

# Accuracy and integration tests — require GPU + model weights
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen3 --test hf_golden_gate
PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH=models/Qwen3.5-4B cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen35 --features qwen35 --test hf_golden_gate
PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH=models/Qwen3.5-4B cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen35 --features qwen35 --test e2e_scheduler

# Single test (filter by name)
cargo test --release --workspace --lib prefix_cache -- --nocapture
```

Qwen accuracy gates compare logits against stored HF golden fixtures. Qwen3.5 exact-text JSON baselines are retired; keep `e2e_scheduler` for scheduler liveness and request-flow coverage.

## Architecture

```
HTTP Request → vLLM frontend → EngineHandle → per-model scheduler/executor → TokenEvent
                                               │
              ┌──────────┬─────────────┬───────┼───────────┬──────────┐
              │          │             │       │           │          │
        pegainfer-  pegainfer-   pegainfer-  pegainfer-  pegainfer-  ...
        qwen3       qwen35       dsv2-lite   kimi-k2     glm52
      (full attn) (linear+full) (MoE+EP)   (MLA+MoE)  (MLA+MoE+FP8)
              │          │             │       │           │          │
              └──────────┴─────────────┴───────┼───────────┴──────────┘
                                               │
                          pegainfer-core runtime + pegainfer-kernels
                                               │
                               ┌───────────────┼───────────────┐
                               │               │               │
                       CUDA / cuBLAS    Triton AOT      FlashInfer
                                                    (sampling, attention,
                                                     norm, MLA decode)

tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

Pure Rust + CUDA LLM inference engine. No PyTorch, no frameworks. OpenAI-compatible `/v1/completions` API.

**Supported models:**

Every model line is behind a cargo feature; only `qwen3` is a default feature, so the stock build is pure Rust + CUDA with no Python.

| Qwen3.5-4B / 9B / 27B · Qwen3.8-27B | `pegainfer-qwen35` | `--features qwen35` (needs build-time Python + Triton) | Hybrid Gated DeltaNet + full attention. Qwen3.8 shares the line: same `model_type`, same text geometry — see `docs/models/qwen35/support-qwen38.md` |

- `PEGAINFER_TRITON_PYTHON` — Python with Triton for `qwen35` build-time AOT kernel generation (falls back to `.venv/bin/python`, then `python3`, then `python`)

- `PEGAINFER_BUILD_TIMING=1` — print per-phase build timings (nvcc, Triton AOT, etc.)
- `PEGAINFER_NVCC_JOBS` — override parallel nvcc job count
- `PEGAINFER_GEMM_LT_CACHE` — opt-in cross-process cublasLt algo store: `<file>` carries the winners `gemm_lt_tune` timed in an earlier boot instead of re-timing them (Qwen3-4B on one sm_89 card: warm ready ~1965 → ~1312 ms, paired 5/5). ## Architecture

```
HTTP Request → vLLM frontend → EngineHandle → per-model scheduler/executor → TokenEvent
                                               │
              ┌──────────┬─────────────┬───────┼───────────┬──────────┐
              │          │             │       │           │          │
        pegainfer-  pegainfer-   pegainfer-  pegainfer-  pegainfer-  ...
        qwen3       qwen35       dsv2-lite   kimi-k2     glm52

              │          │             │       │           │          │
              └──────────┴─────────────┴───────┼───────────┴──────────┘
                                               │
                          pegainfer-core runtime + pegainfer-kernels
                                               │
                               ┌───────────────┼───────────────┐
                               │               │               │
                       CUDA / cuBLAS    Triton AOT      FlashInfer
                                                    (sampling, attention,
                                                     norm, MLA decode)
```

**Key abstractions:**

- **`pegainfer-frontend`** — the serving frontend: the engine request/event contract (`pegainfer_frontend::engine` — `EngineHandle`, `GenerateRequest`, `TokenEvent`) plus the protocol stacks on top of it (`vllm` module today, `dynamo` planned) and the `ModelLine` dispatch trait. Model crates implement against the contract; the server binary does pure dispatch.
- **Per-model crates** — each model owns config, weights, prefill/decode execution, scheduler, tests, and benches.
- **`pegainfer-core::ops`** — shared GPU operator wrappers used by model crates.
- **`pegainfer-kernels`** — tensor/FFI/kernel build owner for CUDA, cuBLAS, FlashInfer, and Triton AOT. Model-specific kernels live in feature-gated submodules (`kimi_k2`, `glm52`).
- **CUDA Graph** — decode path captured inside model executors with pre-allocated buffers to preserve pointer stability.
- **KV state** — model schedulers own request state; shared paged-KV primitives live in `pegainfer-kv-cache`; host/SSD/RDMA offload bridge in `pegainfer-kv-offload`.

**Build system**: the virtual workspace root has no package build script. `pegainfer-kernels/build.rs` owns CUDA/Triton compilation:
1. Compiles `pegainfer-kernels/csrc/*.cu` with nvcc (auto-detects GPU SM targets)
2. Feature-gated codegen: `qwen35` runs Triton AOT via `pegainfer-kernels/tools/triton/gen_triton_aot.py`; `kimi-k2` adds MLA/MoE/Marlin CUDA; `glm52` adds MLA/MoE/FP8 CUDA plus TileLang sparse-MLA codegen on sm_90a

## EP Free-Running Discipline

Canonical doc: `docs/models/glm52/free-running-dp.md` (K3's gang lane follows it). Invariants — violating any of these is a deadlock design:

- **No rank ever stops or waits.** Every engine loop runs unconditionally at full speed; idle ranks step with padding rows. Any quiet wait (condvar, sleep-poll) inside EP coordination is a bug, and the fleet is never asleep, so never design "wake up" or "pump until X" steps.
- **The per-step collective chain is fixed** — no conditional collectives. Skipping work happens inside kernels via zero-load padding entry, never by host negotiation.
- **The launch count is the global clock** (pairing pins all ranks within ±1 launch). Coordination means agreeing ahead of time on *what step N contains*, never "wait until everyone is ready".
- **Padding rows are protocol surface**: their bytes reach peers, so every dummy-row input must be constructively deterministic.

157	**练习 1**：为什么 `frequency_dim` 传 `rotary_dim` 而不是 `head_dim`？传错了会发生什么？
158	**答案**：`frequency_dim` 是频率公式的分母 \(\theta^{-2i/f}\)。传 64 时，64 个被旋转维度在 theta=1e7 的完整频率范围内取值（\(\theta_0=1\)、\(\theta_{31}=10^{-7\times 62/64}\)）；若传 256，所有频率会挤进 \([10^{-7\times 126/256}, 1]\) 的高频段，长文本的位置分辨率劣化——数学上仍是合法 RoPE，但与 HF 权重的预期编码不一致，logits 会对不上。`pegainfer-core/src/rope.rs` 的校验只要求 `rotary_dim <= frequency_dim`，两种都放行，所以这里的取值是与 checkpoint 的对齐约定。

160	**练习 2**：cos 表为什么前后两半重复？不重复（每位置只存 32 个 cos）行不行？

166	### 4.2 paged attention 内核：分页布局、PrefillPagedPlan 与两条调用链
167	
168	#### 4.2.1 概念说明
169	
170	分页 KV 池是一维的 `bf16` 大数组，物理结构由 `KvLayout` 的三个步长完全描述（字段定义在 `pegainfer-kv-cache/src/layout.rs`）：
171	
172	\[
173	\text{kv\_block\_len} = \text{page\_size} \times H_{kv} \times d,
174	\quad
175	\text{layer\_stride} = 2 \times \text{kv\_block\_len},
176	\quad
177	\text{page\_stride} = L_{full} \times \text{layer\_stride}
178	\]
179	
180	即**页 → 层 → K 块/V 块 → token → head → dim** 的逐级嵌套：一页里先按层铺，每层内 K 块在前、V 块紧随，块内按 (token, head, dim) 行主序。4B 代入（页 16 token、4 KV 头、d=256、8 层）：`kv_block_len = 16384` 元素，`layer_stride = 32768`，`page_stride = 262144` 元素 = **512 KiB/页**；摊到每 token 是 \(2 \times 8 \times 4 \times 256 \times 2\text{B} = 32\text{KiB}\)。
181	
182	于是任意 (层 `l`, 页 `p`, token `t`, head `h`, dim `d`) 的 K 地址：
183	
184	\[
185	\text{offset}_K = l \cdot \text{layer\_stride} + p \cdot \text{page\_stride} + (t \cdot H_{kv} + h) \cdot d + \text{dim}
186	\]
187	
188	V 地址只是把第一项换成 `l·layer_stride + kv_block_len`——这正是调用点手算 `layer_k_off`/`layer_v_off` 的公式（[src/prefill.rs:332-335](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/prefill.rs#L332-L335)）。
189	
190	`KvView` 是请求侧的轻量句柄：`(page_indices: Vec<i32>, seq_len, page_size)`，构造时断言**页表恰好覆盖序列**（多一页读到垃圾、少一页越界，注释点名 #291）；`last_page_len()` 在整页时返回 `page_size` 而非 0，使内核能用 `(num_pages-1)·page_size + last_page_len` 还原长度。池容量在加载期按「扣掉 scratch/递推/快照预留后剩余的 85%」折算成页数（[src/weights.rs:316-334](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/weights.rs#L316-L334)）。

192	#### 4.2.2 核心流程
193	
194	**prefill 调用链**（一个 chunk，[src/prefill.rs:305-446](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/prefill.rs#L305-L446)）：
195	
196	```
197	1. q_full = gemm(q_proj[8192×2560], normed)      # Q 与 gate 交错
198	   k     = gemm(k_proj[1024×2560], normed)
199	   v     = gemm(v_proj[1024×2560], normed)
200	2. chunk_view = KvView(全量页表[..page_count], chunk_end)   # 本 chunk 可见的 KV 前缀
201	   plan = PrefillPagedPlan::from_raw_batch_with_cta_tile_q(
202	       页表, [last_page_len], [base_pos], [chunk_len], 16头, 4头, 256, cta_tile_q=0)
203	3. ffi::prefill_attention_hd256_prep_paged_cuda   # 一个内核做三件事:
204	      a. Q/K 各过 [256] 共享 RMSNorm (eps)
205	      b. Q/K 前 64 维查 cos/sin 表做 partial RoPE → q_prepped[4096×seq]
206	      c. K/V 按 start_pos..start_pos+seq 逐 token 写入池(页表寻址)
207	4. ffi::batch_prefill_paged_cuda_hd256            # FA2 式分块注意力, 读池, sm_scale=1/√256
208	5. ffi::attention_gate_batch_hd256_cuda           # attn_out ⊙ sigmoid(gate), 原地
209	6. gemm(o_proj[2560×4096]) → all_reduce_hidden
210	```
211	
212	步骤 2 的 `PrefillPagedPlan`（重导出自 `pegainfer_core::ops`，[src/ops.rs:5](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/ops.rs#L5)）把页表加工成 FA2 内核要的设备侧元数据：`page_indices_d`/`page_indptr_d`（页表 + 前缀和）、`last_page_len_d`、`q_indptr_d`/`request_indices_d`（Q 行归属）、`qo_tile_indices_d`/`kv_tile_indices_d`/`kv_chunk_size_d`/`total_num_rows_d`（Q/KV 分块调度）。`cta_tile_q = 0` 表示让内核按自己的 FA2 推导取 tile（[src/batch_decode.rs:593-596](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/batch_decode.rs#L593-L596) 注释：hd256 FFI 不接受 override）。

258	### 4.3 head_dim=256 约定：编译期门、sm_scale 与 GQA 路由
259	
260	#### 4.3.1 概念说明
261	
262	函数名后缀 `hd256` 不只是命名习惯，而是**编译期事实**：这些内核按 head_dim=256 特化（CTA 内的寄存器/共享内存布局按 256 定宽），所以 config 校验层直接把「head_dim ≠ 256」挡在加载期。约定在三个层面落地：
263	
264	1. **config 门**：`FULL_ATTN_HEAD_DIM = 256` 常量 + `FullAttnHeadDimMismatch` 错误（[src/config/model.rs:60-68](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/config/model.rs#L60-L68) 的注释说得直白："a config that passes here is one the kernels can run"；具体比对在 [src/config/model.rs:242-247](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/config/model.rs#L242-L247)）。
265	2. **调用点常量**：prefill 用本地 `const HEAD_DIM: usize = 256`（[src/prefill.rs:21](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/prefill.rs#L21)）传给内核，并据此取 `sm_scale = 1/√256 = 0.0625`（[src/prefill.rs:376](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/prefill.rs#L376)）——注意分母是**全头维 256**，不是被旋转的 64：softmax 缩放补偿的是 QK 内积的方差，内积在全部 256 维上累加。
266	3. **decode 路由**：GQA 组比率 \(H_q/H_{kv}\) 决定用哪条 decode 内核路线，见下。
267	
268	**GQA 路由的完整决策树**（4B 组比率为 4）：
269	
270	```
271	decode_group_is_compiled()?            # 组比率 ∈ SUPPORTED_GQA_GROUP_SIZES = [1,2,3,4,6,8]
272	├─ 否（清单外比率，如 32/4=8 之外的奇数组）
273	│   → batched hybrid 回退: 全注意力走 via_prefill
274	│     (paged_attention_batch_decode_via_prefill_hd256_into, 1-token PrefillPagedPlan)
275	│     且只允许 Serve 模式(不能进 CUDA Graph 的 Capture/Replay)
276	└─ 是
277	    ├─ bs ≤ 16 且 组比率 == 4 → split-KV 内核 (paged_attention_batch_decode_split_hd256_into)
278	    └─ 否则                    → FlashInfer 批量内核 (paged_attention_batch_decode_hd256_into)
279	```
280	
281	split-KV 路线的动机写在常量注释里（[src/decode_buffers.rs:12-29](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/decode_buffers.rs#L12-L29)）：FlashInfer 批量内核每 (请求, KV 头) 只开一个 CTA、grid 不随 KV 长度增长——bs=1 时全卡只有 4 个 CTA 在跑；把 KV 区间切成 `splits` 份并行、两阶段归约，小 batch 全面占优（注释附实测：bs1 9.41→8.57 ms）。`split_decode_splits` 每桶固定（bs≤2 用 32、否则 16，[src/decode_buffers.rs:31-41](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/decode_buffers.rs#L31-L41)）——切分数必须**不随 KV 长度变**，否则 CUDA Graph 桶的 grid 形状不稳定（注释原话 "has to be constant across a captured CUDA Graph bucket"）。

363	#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案
364	
365	**练习 1**：为什么 `split_decode_splits` 按桶固定，而不是按当前 KV 长度动态取最优？
366	**答案**：CUDA Graph 重放要求网格形状在捕获时定死。decode 的图按桶捕获（u4-l3 详述），同一条重放要在任意 KV 长度下正确；若 splits 随长度变，重放的 grid 与捕获时不同，轻则性能劣化重则读越界。注释给出的策略是「每桶取曲线拐点值，过长请求让后面的 CTA 空转」——空 CTA 是正确性安全的。同时这也解释了 `SPLIT_DECODE_MAX_SPLITS = 32` 的存在：partial 缓冲要按上界一次性定容。
367	
368	**练习 2**：`qk_norm_partial_rope_batched_decode_hd256_into` 为什么把「Q 从 q_full 抽取」也做进内核，而不是先用一个独立的 gather 内核？
369	**答案**：因为 `q_full` 的行是 per-head `[q | gate]` 交错块，Q 带与 gate 带不在连续行段里（u2-l4 的 gated-q 布局）。任何「先抽取再 norm+RoPE」的方案都要多一次全局读写 4096 宽的中间缓冲。融成一个内核后，Q 带在读进寄存器/共享内存的同一步完成 norm、RoPE 与重排写出，省一次往返；gate 带则留给第 4 步的 `attention_gate_batch_hd256_cuda` 原地消费。两个内核各自只读一次 `q_full`，是「一次 GEMM 两种用途」的最终落点。
370	
371	**练习 3**：Qwen3.8-27B 的全注意力是 24 Q / 4 KV 头（比率 6）。它在本讲的决策树上怎么走？`SPLIT_DECODE_GQA_GROUP` 为什么不顺便支持 6？
372	**答案**：比率 6 在 `SUPPORTED_GQA_GROUP_SIZES` 清单内（FlashInfer 有编译实例），所以不走 hybrid；但 split 条件要求本地比率恰等于 4（`SPLIT_DECODE_GQA_GROUP`，注释说该内核 "one warp each" 按组 4 的 warp 布局手写），因此每个桶都走 hd256 批量内核——大 batch 下这正是注释实测里更优的路线。不为 6 再写一版 split 内核是收益问题：split 的优势区间（bs≤16）在 27B 的负载里占比小，多一版特化内核的维护成本大于收益。这与 4.3.1「正确性优先，性能按实测逐路线开闸」的思路一致。

401	## 6. 本讲小结
402	
403	- **RoPE 缓存**：加载期按 `max_position_embeddings × rotary_dim` 一次建满（4B 每表 32 MiB），half-split 重复布局让内核线性寻址；`frequency_dim = rotary_dim` 是与 checkpoint 的对齐约定；运行期只有 `ensure_rope_cache_covers` 纯校验（prefill 整段预检、decode 逐请求），**没有扩容路径**。

# 全注意力层：paged KV、partial RoPE 与 hd256 内核族

## 1. 本讲目标

学完本讲，你应该能够：

1. 追踪 hd256 全注意力 **prefill / decode 两条内核调用链**的每一个封装函数与参数，说出每个指针参数对应哪块显存、每个整数参数来自 config 还是 geometry。
2. 理解 **partial RoPE** 的 cos/sin 缓存组织：为什么只旋转每头前 `rotary_dim = 64` 维、表为什么是 half-split 重复布局、以及运行期的「覆盖守卫」`ensure_rope_cache_covers` 到底检查什么（并澄清：它**不**扩容）。
3. 画出 **分页 KV 池**的物理布局（页 → 层 → K/V 块 → token → head → dim），用 `KvLayout` 的三个步长公式手算任意 (层, 页, token, head) 的元素偏移。
4. 解释 **qk_norm 与 GQA 分组如何在内核参数里表达**：`[head_dim]` 共享权重指针 + `num_attention_heads`/`num_key_value_heads` 这对整数，以及 GQA 组比率如何在 decode 侧决定三条内核路线（split-KV / FlashInfer 批量 / via-prefill 回退）。

## 2. 前置知识

本讲直接承接 u2-l4：你已经知道 `FullAttentionLayer` 只装权重、前向五步是「投影 → 融合预备 → paged attention → gate → o_proj」、`q_proj` 行含 per-head `[q | gate]` 交错块。本讲把其中的「融合预备」「paged attention」两步放大到参数级。再补三段直觉：

**为什么 KV 要分页**。如果把每个请求的 KV cache 放在一整块连续显存里，请求一长一短、来了又走，显存很快碎片化。分页方案把池切成固定大小的**页**（page，这里 16 个 token 一页），每个请求持有一张「页号表」，逻辑上连续、物理上散落。注意力内核不再假设 K/V 连续，而是拿 `page_indices` 数组间接寻址。描述「一个请求的 KV 长什么样」的类型就是 `KvView`（页号表 + 序列长 + 页大小），池本身是 `KvBuffer`——都来自 workspace 的 `pegainfer-kv-cache` crate（`layout.rs` / `view.rs` / `buffer.rs`）。

**什么是 partial RoPE**。RoPE（旋转位置编码）把每个 token 的 Q/K 向量按其位置旋转一个角度，让内积自然携带相对位置信息。**partial** 指只旋转每头前 `rotary_dim` 维（Qwen3.5 是 `head_dim × partial_rotary_factor = 256 × 0.25 = 64` 维），其余 192 维原样通过。旋转角只依赖 (位置, 维度对)，与 token 内容无关，所以整张 cos/sin 表可以在**模型加载时一次性预计算**，前向只查表——这就是「RoPE 缓存」。

**什么是 GQA**。Grouped-Query Attention：16 个 query head 共享 4 组 KV head（组比率 4），K/V 的存储与计算量直接除以 4。内核拿到 `num_attention_heads` 与 `num_key_value_heads` 两个数自己算分组；这个比率还决定了哪些 decode 内核可用（见 4.3）。

本讲所有具体数字以 **Qwen3.5-4B** 为例（出处 `docs/models/qwen35/decode-kernel-attribution.md`：hidden 2560，32 层 = 24 linear + 8 full attention，16 q heads / 4 kv heads，head_dim 256，GQA 4，vocab 248320；`docs/models/qwen35/optimization.md`：rotary_dim=64，theta=1e7）：

| 量 | 值 | 来源 |
|---|---|---|
| `hidden_size` | 2560 | config.json |
| 全注意力层（也即 KV 池层数） | 8 | `layer_types` 计数 |
| `num_attention_heads` / `num_key_value_heads` | 16 / 4 | config.json |
| `head_dim` | 256 | config.json（内核编译期约定） |
| `rotary_dim` | 256 × 0.25 = 64 | [src/config/model.rs:219-222](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/config/model.rs#L219-L222) |
| `q_dim` / gated q 维 / `kv_dim` | 4096 / 8192 / 1024 | heads × head_dim（gate 翻倍） |
| `page_size` | 16 | [src/weights.rs:262](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/weights.rs#L262) |
| `max_position_embeddings` | 262144 | config.json |

内核本体在本 crate 之外，供对照：封装在 `pegainfer-kernels/src/ops/qwen35.rs`，CUDA 实现在 `pegainfer-kernels/csrc/qwen35/prefill_attention_hd256.cu`；RoPE 表生成在 `pegainfer-core/src/rope.rs`；分页池在 `pegainfer-kv-cache/src/{layout,view,buffer}.rs`。

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 RoPE 缓存：partial 旋转的查表与覆盖守卫

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

RoPE 对每对维度 \((i,\, i+h)\)（\(h = \text{rotary\_dim}/2\)）施加随位置 \(p\) 旋转的二维旋转：

\[
\begin{pmatrix} x'_i \\ x'_{i+h} \end{pmatrix}
=
\begin{pmatrix}
\cos(p\theta_i) & -\sin(p\theta_i) \\
\sin(p\theta_i) & \cos(p\theta_i)
\end{pmatrix}
\begin{pmatrix} x_i \\ x_{i+h} \end{pmatrix},
\qquad
\theta_i = \text{theta}^{-2i/\text{rotary\_dim}}
\]

要点有三个：

1. **旋转角与内容无关**，只依赖 \((p, i)\)——所以 `\cos(p\theta_i)`、`\sin(p\theta_i)` 可以整表预计算，内核里零三角函数。
2. **partial**：只对每头前 64 维做上述变换（\(i \in [0, 32)\)，搭档是 \(i+32\)），第 64 维起原样拷贝。CUDA 预备内核里就是这样写的：`d >= rotary_dim` 的分量直接 `q_batch_out[dst + d] = smem[d]`。
3. **half-split（对半拆）布局**：Q/K 向量被当作「前半 32 维 + 后半 32 维」两段，旋转在两段**同下标**之间配对进行。为了让内核按下标线性读取，cos/sin 表每位置存成 `[cos(0)..cos(31), cos(0)..cos(31)]` ——**前后两半重复**。这是 NeoX 系 RoPE 的标准 trick，`pegainfer-core/src/rope.rs` 的 `tables()` 注释原话是 "Half-split layout"。

缓存属于**模型**而不是层：所有 8 个全注意力层共享同一张表（`Qwen35Model` 的字段，[src/weights.rs:65-67](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/weights.rs#L65-L67)，注释即 `[max_seq_len * rotary_dim]`）。

> **勘误（相对本讲规划稿）**：规划稿写「按需扩容」，但当前代码**没有扩容路径**——表在加载期按 `max_position_embeddings` 一次建满（262144 个位置），运行期只有 `ensure_rope_cache_covers` 这个**纯校验守卫**：超覆盖即报错，绝不重算。学习以代码为准。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

```
加载期（一次）:
  rotary_dim = head_dim × partial_rotary_factor          # config 校验，0 即拒绝
  cos/sin ← precompute_rope(RopeTableSpec{
      rotary_dim, frequency_dim: rotary_dim,             # 两者相等 → 频率基只用 rotary_dim
      max_seq_len: max_position_embeddings, theta })
  # 每张表 262144 × 64 个 bf16 = 32 MiB，两张共 64 MiB

前向期（每步，零计算只查表）:
  prefill: 整段先校验 ensure_rope_cache_covers(end_pos)，再进预备内核
  decode:  逐请求校验 ensure_rope_cache_covers(pos + 1)，内核按 positions_d 查表
```

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

**rotary_dim 的出生地**。[src/config/model.rs:219-222](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/config/model.rs#L219-L222)：

```rust
let rotary_dim = (t.head_dim as f64 * t.rope_parameters.partial_rotary_factor) as usize;
if rotary_dim == 0 {
    return Err(ConfigError::ZeroRotaryDim);
}
```

`partial_rotary_factor` 与 `rope_theta` 只从 `rope_parameters` 块读这两个键（[src/config/model.rs:22-27](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/config/model.rs#L22-L27)）。4B：256 × 0.25 = 64。

**预计算调用**。[src/weights.rs:236-248](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/weights.rs#L236-L248)：

```rust
let (cos_cache, sin_cache) = precompute_rope(
    &ctx,
    &RopeTableSpec {
        rotary_dim: config.rotary_dim,
        frequency_dim: config.rotary_dim,   // 频率分母也用 64，不是 256
        max_seq_len: config.max_position_embeddings,
        theta: config.rope_theta,
    },
)?;
```

注意 `frequency_dim = rotary_dim`：频率 \(\theta_i = \text{theta}^{-2i/64}\) 在被旋转的 64 维里走完整个频率范围，而不是摊到 256 维上——这是 partial RoPE 与「全旋转只取前 64 维」的关键区别。表布局是 `[位置 × rotary_dim]`，位置 `pos` 落在偏移 `pos * rotary_dim` 处，内核索引正是 `cos_cache[pos * rotary_dim + d]`。

**覆盖守卫**。[src/weights.rs:407-415](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/weights.rs#L407-L415)：

```rust
pub(crate) fn ensure_rope_cache_covers(&self, positions: usize) -> Result<()> {
    let cache_positions = self.cos_cache.len / self.config.rotary_dim;
    anyhow::ensure!(
        positions <= cache_positions,
        "Qwen3.5 RoPE cache covers {cache_positions} positions, requested {positions}; ...",
    );
    Ok(())
}
```

细节有二：它从**实际缓冲长度**反推覆盖数（`len / rotary_dim`），不信任 config 字段——即使未来有人改小缓冲，守卫依然正确；其次调用时机分层——prefill 在动任何状态**之前**对整段终点校验（`end_pos`，[src/prefill.rs:69-87](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/prefill.rs#L69-L87)，与位置溢出、KV 视图长度一起构成「先整段校验后变更」），decode 则在每个请求自己的位置上校验（`pos + 1`，[src/batch_decode.rs:329](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/batch_decode.rs#L329)、[src/batch_decode.rs:465](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/batch_decode.rs#L465)）。由于 `end_pos ≤ max_position_embeddings` 已在 prefill 入口挡了一道，这道守卫当前实际是纵深防御。

**消费点**。prefill 把两张表的指针直接塞进融合预备内核（[src/prefill.rs:344-345](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/prefill.rs#L344-L345)）；decode 侧 `qk_norm_partial_rope_batched_decode_hd256_into` 的参数表里同样有 `cos_cache`/`sin_cache`/`positions_d` 三件套（[src/batch_decode.rs:130-144](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/batch_decode.rs#L130-L144)）。两条路径查的是**同一张表**，这也是「表属于模型」的直接收益。

#### 4.1.4 代码实践

**实践目标**：纸上验证缓存尺寸与守卫边界，确认「一次建满、绝不扩容」。

**操作步骤**：

1. 用 4B 数字手算：`rotary_dim`、一张表的元素数（`max_position_embeddings × rotary_dim`）、bf16 字节数、两张表合计。
2. 读 [src/weights.rs:407-415](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/weights.rs#L407-L415)，回答：`ensure_rope_cache_covers(262144)` 通过吗？`262145` 呢？提示：`positions <= cache_positions`，边界取等。
3. 用 `Grep` 在 `src/` 搜 `precompute_rope`，确认全 crate 只有一处调用（加载期）；再搜 `ensure_rope_cache_covers` 数一数调用点，按 prefill / eager decode / graph decode / hybrid decode 归类。

**需要观察的现象**：`precompute_rope` 仅出现在 weights.rs 加载路径；四个守卫调用点全部在「位置即将被使用」的现场，且都在内核发射**之前**。

**预期结果**：表元素数 = 262144 × 64 = 16,777,216，单表 32 MiB（bf16），cos+sin 共 64 MiB；`262144` 通过（取等），`262145` 报错。守卫调用点：prefill.rs:87 一个 + batch_decode.rs 三个（eager 329、graph 465、hybrid 549）。

#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么 `frequency_dim` 传 `rotary_dim` 而不是 `head_dim`？传错了会发生什么？
**答案**：`frequency_dim` 是频率公式的分母 \(\theta^{-2i/f}\)。传 64 时，64 个被旋转维度在 theta=1e7 的完整频率范围内取值（\(\theta_0=1\)、\(\theta_{31}=10^{-7\times 62/64}\)）；若传 256，所有频率会挤进 \([10^{-7\times 126/256}, 1]\) 的高频段，长文本的位置分辨率劣化——数学上仍是合法 RoPE，但与 HF 权重的预期编码不一致，logits 会对不上。`pegainfer-core/src/rope.rs` 的校验只要求 `rotary_dim <= frequency_dim`，两种都放行，所以这里的取值是与 checkpoint 的对齐约定。

**练习 2**：cos 表为什么前后两半重复？不重复（每位置只存 32 个 cos）行不行？
**答案**：行，但内核要多一次地址判断。half-split 布局下 Q/K 的第 \(i\) 维与第 \(i+32\) 维配对旋转，两行都要读 \(\cos(p\theta_i)\)；表若按 64 项存（重复两半），两行的读取地址就是线性的 `base + i` 与 `base + i + 32`，无需分支。这是用 2 倍显存（每表 32 MiB 而非 16 MiB）换内核寻址的简化——在 64 MiB 量级上，这笔交易显然划算。

**练习 3**：decode 为什么是 `ensure_rope_cache_covers(pos + 1)` 而不是 `pos`？
**答案**：`pos = view.seq_len() - 1` 是**本步要写入的 token 位置**（KvView 描述的是步后长度，[src/batch_decode.rs:319-323](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/batch_decode.rs#L319-L323) 的注释）。查表需要覆盖**闭区间** `[0, pos]`，即「前 pos+1 个位置都有表项」；只查 `pos` 会漏掉边界：若表恰好只建到 `pos` 项，位置 `pos` 本身就越界了。prefill 侧传 `end_pos`（开区间终点，位置上限 `end_pos - 1`）与此等价。

### 4.2 paged attention 内核：分页布局、PrefillPagedPlan 与两条调用链

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

分页 KV 池是一维的 `bf16` 大数组，物理结构由 `KvLayout` 的三个步长完全描述（字段定义在 `pegainfer-kv-cache/src/layout.rs`）：

\[
\text{kv\_block\_len} = \text{page\_size} \times H_{kv} \times d,
\quad
\text{layer\_stride} = 2 \times \text{kv\_block\_len},
\quad
\text{page\_stride} = L_{full} \times \text{layer\_stride}
\]

即**页 → 层 → K 块/V 块 → token → head → dim** 的逐级嵌套：一页里先按层铺，每层内 K 块在前、V 块紧随，块内按 (token, head, dim) 行主序。4B 代入（页 16 token、4 KV 头、d=256、8 层）：`kv_block_len = 16384` 元素，`layer_stride = 32768`，`page_stride = 262144` 元素 = **512 KiB/页**；摊到每 token 是 \(2 \times 8 \times 4 \times 256 \times 2\text{B} = 32\text{KiB}\)。

于是任意 (层 `l`, 页 `p`, token `t`, head `h`, dim `d`) 的 K 地址：

\[
\text{offset}_K = l \cdot \text{layer\_stride} + p \cdot \text{page\_stride} + (t \cdot H_{kv} + h) \cdot d + \text{dim}
\]

V 地址只是把第一项换成 `l·layer_stride + kv_block_len`——这正是调用点手算 `layer_k_off`/`layer_v_off` 的公式（[src/prefill.rs:332-335](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/prefill.rs#L332-L335)）。

`KvView` 是请求侧的轻量句柄：`(page_indices: Vec<i32>, seq_len, page_size)`，构造时断言**页表恰好覆盖序列**（多一页读到垃圾、少一页越界，注释点名 #291）；`last_page_len()` 在整页时返回 `page_size` 而非 0，使内核能用 `(num_pages-1)·page_size + last_page_len` 还原长度。池容量在加载期按「扣掉 scratch/递推/快照预留后剩余的 85%」折算成页数（[src/weights.rs:316-334](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/weights.rs#L316-L334)）。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

**prefill 调用链**（一个 chunk，[src/prefill.rs:305-446](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/prefill.rs#L305-L446)）：

```
1. q_full = gemm(q_proj[8192×2560], normed)      # Q 与 gate 交错
   k     = gemm(k_proj[1024×2560], normed)
   v     = gemm(v_proj[1024×2560], normed)
2. chunk_view = KvView(全量页表[..page_count], chunk_end)   # 本 chunk 可见的 KV 前缀
   plan = PrefillPagedPlan::from_raw_batch_with_cta_tile_q(
       页表, [last_page_len], [base_pos], [chunk_len], 16头, 4头, 256, cta_tile_q=0)
3. ffi::prefill_attention_hd256_prep_paged_cuda   # 一个内核做三件事:
      a. Q/K 各过 [256] 共享 RMSNorm (eps)
      b. Q/K 前 64 维查 cos/sin 表做 partial RoPE → q_prepped[4096×seq]
      c. K/V 按 start_pos..start_pos+seq 逐 token 写入池(页表寻址)
4. ffi::batch_prefill_paged_cuda_hd256            # FA2 式分块注意力, 读池, sm_scale=1/√256
5. ffi::attention_gate_batch_hd256_cuda           # attn_out ⊙ sigmoid(gate), 原地
6. gemm(o_proj[2560×4096]) → all_reduce_hidden
```

步骤 2 的 `PrefillPagedPlan`（重导出自 `pegainfer_core::ops`，[src/ops.rs:5](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/ops.rs#L5)）把页表加工成 FA2 内核要的设备侧元数据：`page_indices_d`/`page_indptr_d`（页表 + 前缀和）、`last_page_len_d`、`q_indptr_d`/`request_indices_d`（Q 行归属）、`qo_tile_indices_d`/`kv_tile_indices_d`/`kv_chunk_size_d`/`total_num_rows_d`（Q/KV 分块调度）。`cta_tile_q = 0` 表示让内核按自己的 FA2 推导取 tile（[src/batch_decode.rs:593-596](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/batch_decode.rs#L593-L596) 注释：hd256 FFI 不接受 override）。

**decode 调用链**（[src/batch_decode.rs:112-214](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/batch_decode.rs#L112-L214)）结构同构，两处关键差异：

- **谁写池**：decode 的预备内核 `qk_norm_partial_rope_batched_decode_hd256_into` 只做 QK-norm + partial RoPE（Q 从交错的 `q_full` 抽取到 `q_attn`、K 原地处理），**不碰池**；本步 K/V 的落页藏在注意力包装函数开头——`paged_attention_batch_decode_*_hd256_into` 内部先调 `scatter_decode_kv_into_paged` 按 `positions_d` 写池再发射注意力内核。u2-l4 已指出这个不对称，本讲看参数就知道为什么：decode 预备内核签名里根本没有页表与池指针（[src/batch_decode.rs:130-144](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/batch_decode.rs#L130-L144)）。
- **位置语义**：prefill 每个 chunk 一个标量 `start_pos`（单个 `i32` 上传，[src/prefill.rs:327-331](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/prefill.rs#L327-L331)）；decode 是**每请求一个位置**的 `positions_d` 数组——N 个请求各 1 token，各查各的表、各写各的页。

#### 4.2.3 源码精读

**chunk 视图与 plan 构建**。[src/prefill.rs:94-120](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/prefill.rs#L94-L120)：`page_count = chunk_end.div_ceil(page_size)`，chunk 视图截取全量页表的前缀——前一个 chunk 写过的页对本 chunk 可见（因果性由 `start_pos` 起点保证）。plan 参数按请求逐项传单元素切片（prefill 的 plan 只装这一个 chunk 的这一个请求）。

**偏移手算现场**。分两处：[src/prefill.rs:121-135](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/prefill.rs#L121-L135) 把池裸指针、`KvLayout`、plan 与 `base_pos` 打包成 `PrefillKvAccess` 一路传下去；随后 [src/prefill.rs:332-335](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/prefill.rs#L332-L335) 算出 `layer_k_off = full_idx * layer_stride`、`layer_v_off = layer_k_off + kv_block_len`、`stride_page = page_stride` 三个 `i64`——它们就是地址公式的三项系数。

**prep 内核的参数表**。[src/prefill.rs:337-373](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/prefill.rs#L337-L373) 一次 FFI 调用吃进 20 个参数，按用途分四组：输入投影 `q_full/k/v`；norm 与位置 `q_norm/k_norm/cos/sin/start_pos`；输出 `q_prepped` 与池 `buf + layer_k_off/layer_v_off/page_indices`；几何 `num_attention_heads/num_key_value_heads/seq_len/rotary_dim/eps/page_size/stride_page`。**qk_norm 与 GQA 的表达就在这里**：norm 是两个 `[256]` 指针（head 共享，u2-l4 讲过权重形状），GQA 是 `16/4` 这对整数——内核按 `kv_head = q_head / (H_q/H_kv)` 把 query head 映射到 KV head。

**prefill 注意力内核**。[src/prefill.rs:375-423](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/prefill.rs#L375-L423)：输入 `q_prepped` 与九个 plan 设备数组 + `layer_k_off/layer_v_off` + 几何 + `sm_scale`，返回码非 0 时用 `ffi_exception_message` 展开错误（这是 prefill 侧唯一检查返回码的 hd256 调用）。

**decode 的页表上传**。[src/decode_buffers.rs:216-267](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/decode_buffers.rs#L216-L267)：`sync_paged_views` 把 N 个 `KvView` 拼成扁平页表 + `indptr` 前缀和 + `last_page_len` + `kv_chunk_size`，一次 H2D 上传。**padding 槽指向保留页**（`padding_page_id`，seq_len=1）——CUDA Graph 重放时 batch 桶固定，凑不满的行也要让内核读到合法地址，这是 u4-l3 的伏笔，此处先记住「padding 行的页表项是真的」。

#### 4.2.4 代码实践

**实践目标**：给定一个请求（seq_len=128，页表 `[P0..P7]`），手算 decode 一步的全部页表元数据与第 3 个全注意力层的池偏移。

**操作步骤**：

1. 算页数与尾页长：`128.div_ceil(16)`、`128 % 16`（注意 `last_page_len` 整页时的特殊返回值，去看 `KvView::last_page_len` 的实现或本讲 4.2.1）。
2. 写出 `sync_paged_views` 上传后的五个数组内容（batch=1、无 padding）：`page_indices_d`、`page_indptr_d`、`last_page_len_d`、`kv_chunk_size_d`、`request_indices_d`，以及 `positions_d`（decode 位 = `seq_len - 1`）。
3. 用 4B 布局常量算 `full_idx = 3` 这一层的 `layer_k_off`、`layer_v_off`、`stride_page`（元素数），再算 token 127 的 K 在页 `P7` 内的块内偏移（`token_in_page × H_kv × d + ...`，`token_in_page = 127 % 16`）。

**需要观察的现象**：第 3 步的三个池级系数与请求无关（只由布局决定），块内偏移与请求无关（只由 token 在页内的位置决定）——**请求的个体性全部收敛在页表里**，这正是分页设计的意图。

**预期结果**：8 页、`last_page_len = 16`（整页返回 page_size 而非 0）；`page_indices_d = [P0..P7]`，`page_indptr_d = [0, 8]`，`last_page_len_d = [16]`，`kv_chunk_size_d = [128]`，`request_indices_d = [0]`，`positions_d = [127]`；`layer_k_off = 3 × 32768 = 98304`，`layer_v_off = 98304 + 16384 = 114688`，`stride_page = 262144`；token 127 在页内偏移 15，K 块内偏移起点 `15 × 1024 = 15360`。

#### 4.2.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么 `KvView::new` 要断言「页数恰好等于 `seq_len.div_ceil(page_size)`」？给一个具体后果。
**答案**：内核用 `(num_pages - 1) × page_size + last_page_len` 还原序列长度并按页表访存。若页表多一页（如 128 token 挂 9 页），attention 会把第 9 页的陈旧/未初始化 K/V 当作合法历史算进 softmax——输出悄悄错，不越界不报错；少一页则直接越界读（注释引用的 #291 就是这类）。所以「恰好覆盖」在构造点用 `assert_eq!` 拦截。

**练习 2**：prefill 的 plan 参数里 `[base_pos + offset]` 与 `[chunk.len()]` 分别控制什么？
**答案**：前者是本 chunk 的起始绝对位置——既决定 RoPE 查表起点（预备内核用它推每个 token 的位置），也决定 K/V 落页的写入位置；后者是本 chunk 的 token 数，决定 plan 生成的 Q 行数与调度 tile 数。二者配合实现「多 chunk 串起来等价于一次整段 prefill」：位置连续、页表前缀叠加、recurrent 状态逐 chunk 推进。

**练习 3**：decode 的 `kv_chunk_size_d` 上传的是 `view.seq_len()`（如 128），为什么不是 1？这个 chunk 是给谁看的？
**答案**：它描述的是**KV 侧**的长度（该请求的池内历史共 128 个 token），不是本步 Q 的长度（Q 恒为 1 行）。split-KV 内核按 `kv_chunk_size` 把 KV 区间切成 `splits` 份并行归约；Q 侧的「每请求 1 行」由 `q_indptr`/`request_indices` 表达。一个数组管 KV 维度、一组索引管 Q 归属，两套元数据各司其职。

### 4.3 head_dim=256 约定：编译期门、sm_scale 与 GQA 路由

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

函数名后缀 `hd256` 不只是命名习惯，而是**编译期事实**：这些内核按 head_dim=256 特化（CTA 内的寄存器/共享内存布局按 256 定宽），所以 config 校验层直接把「head_dim ≠ 256」挡在加载期。约定在三个层面落地：

1. **config 门**：`FULL_ATTN_HEAD_DIM = 256` 常量 + `FullAttnHeadDimMismatch` 错误（[src/config/model.rs:60-68](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/config/model.rs#L60-L68) 的注释说得直白："a config that passes here is one the kernels can run"；具体比对在 [src/config/model.rs:242-247](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/config/model.rs#L242-L247)）。
2. **调用点常量**：prefill 用本地 `const HEAD_DIM: usize = 256`（[src/prefill.rs:21](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/prefill.rs#L21)）传给内核，并据此取 `sm_scale = 1/√256 = 0.0625`（[src/prefill.rs:376](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/prefill.rs#L376)）——注意分母是**全头维 256**，不是被旋转的 64：softmax 缩放补偿的是 QK 内积的方差，内积在全部 256 维上累加。
3. **decode 路由**：GQA 组比率 \(H_q/H_{kv}\) 决定用哪条 decode 内核路线，见下。

**GQA 路由的完整决策树**（4B 组比率为 4）：

```
decode_group_is_compiled()?            # 组比率 ∈ SUPPORTED_GQA_GROUP_SIZES = [1,2,3,4,6,8]
├─ 否（清单外比率，如 32/4=8 之外的奇数组）
│   → batched hybrid 回退: 全注意力走 via_prefill
│     (paged_attention_batch_decode_via_prefill_hd256_into, 1-token PrefillPagedPlan)
│     且只允许 Serve 模式(不能进 CUDA Graph 的 Capture/Replay)
└─ 是
    ├─ bs ≤ 16 且 组比率 == 4 → split-KV 内核 (paged_attention_batch_decode_split_hd256_into)
    └─ 否则                    → FlashInfer 批量内核 (paged_attention_batch_decode_hd256_into)
```

split-KV 路线的动机写在常量注释里（[src/decode_buffers.rs:12-29](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/decode_buffers.rs#L12-L29)）：FlashInfer 批量内核每 (请求, KV 头) 只开一个 CTA、grid 不随 KV 长度增长——bs=1 时全卡只有 4 个 CTA 在跑；把 KV 区间切成 `splits` 份并行、两阶段归约，小 batch 全面占优（注释附实测：bs1 9.41→8.57 ms）。`split_decode_splits` 每桶固定（bs≤2 用 32、否则 16，[src/decode_buffers.rs:31-41](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/decode_buffers.rs#L31-L41)）——切分数必须**不随 KV 长度变**，否则 CUDA Graph 桶的 grid 形状不稳定（注释原话 "has to be constant across a captured CUDA Graph bucket"）。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

decode 侧全注意力一步的完整路由（对照 [src/batch_decode.rs:126-213](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/batch_decode.rs#L126-L213)）：

```
输入 normed [2560, bs]（bs 已按桶取整）
1. q_full[8192,bs] / k_attn[1024,bs] / v_attn[1024,bs] ← 三个 gemm_into
2. qk_norm_partial_rope_batched_decode_hd256_into:
      q_attn[4096,bs] ← Q 带(norm+RoPE), k_attn 原地(norm+RoPE), gate 带留在 q_full
3. 路由:
   bs≤16 且 16/4==SPLIT_DECODE_GQA_GROUP(4):
      split 内核: 先 scatter 本步 K/V 入池, 再按 splits 份切 KV,
        partial_o/m/l 归并 → attn_out_full[4096,bs]
   否则: hd256 批量内核(同样先 scatter)
4. attention_gate_batch_hd256_cuda: attn_out_full ⊙ sigmoid(gate) 原地
5. gemm_into(o_proj) → attn_results[2560,bs] → all_reduce_hidden
```

#### 4.3.3 源码精读

**编译清单的查询**。[src/config/model.rs:148-152](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/config/model.rs#L148-L152)：

```rust
pub(crate) fn decode_group_is_compiled(&self) -> bool {
    // Uncompiled GQA groups use the batched hybrid eager fallback.
    pegainfer_core::ops::SUPPORTED_GQA_GROUP_SIZES
        .contains(&(self.num_attention_heads / self.num_key_value_heads))

#### 4.3.4 代码实践

**实践目标**：对 5 个场景判定 decode 走哪条全注意力路线，并写明依据。

2. 对下表每行给出路线（split / hd256 / via_prefill-hybrid）与 `splits` 值（若走 split）：

| 场景 | 模型几何（H_q/H_kv） | TP | 桶 bs |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | 4B：16/4 | 1 | 1 |
| B | 4B：16/4 | 1 | 32 |
| C | 4B：16/4 | 2 | 8 |
| D | 某模型：8/4（比率 2） | 1 | 4 |
| E | 某模型：16/5（比率 3.2） | 1 | 4 |

#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么 `split_decode_splits` 按桶固定，而不是按当前 KV 长度动态取最优？
**答案**：CUDA Graph 重放要求网格形状在捕获时定死。decode 的图按桶捕获（u4-l3 详述），同一条重放要在任意 KV 长度下正确；若 splits 随长度变，重放的 grid 与捕获时不同，轻则性能劣化重则读越界。注释给出的策略是「每桶取曲线拐点值，过长请求让后面的 CTA 空转」——空 CTA 是正确性安全的。同时这也解释了 `SPLIT_DECODE_MAX_SPLITS = 32` 的存在：partial 缓冲要按上界一次性定容。

**练习 2**：`qk_norm_partial_rope_batched_decode_hd256_into` 为什么把「Q 从 q_full 抽取」也做进内核，而不是先用一个独立的 gather 内核？
**答案**：因为 `q_full` 的行是 per-head `[q | gate]` 交错块，Q 带与 gate 带不在连续行段里（u2-l4 的 gated-q 布局）。任何「先抽取再 norm+RoPE」的方案都要多一次全局读写 4096 宽的中间缓冲。融成一个内核后，Q 带在读进寄存器/共享内存的同一步完成 norm、RoPE 与重排写出，省一次往返；gate 带则留给第 4 步的 `attention_gate_batch_hd256_cuda` 原地消费。两个内核各自只读一次 `q_full`，是「一次 GEMM 两种用途」的最终落点。

**练习 3**：Qwen3.8-27B 的全注意力是 24 Q / 4 KV 头（比率 6）。它在本讲的决策树上怎么走？`SPLIT_DECODE_GQA_GROUP` 为什么不顺便支持 6？
**答案**：比率 6 在 `SUPPORTED_GQA_GROUP_SIZES` 清单内（FlashInfer 有编译实例），所以不走 hybrid；但 split 条件要求本地比率恰等于 4（`SPLIT_DECODE_GQA_GROUP`，注释说该内核 "one warp each" 按组 4 的 warp 布局手写），因此每个桶都走 hd256 批量内核——大 batch 下这正是注释实测里更优的路线。不为 6 再写一版 split 内核是收益问题：split 的优势区间（bs≤16）在 27B 的负载里占比小，多一版特化内核的维护成本大于收益。这与 4.3.1「正确性优先，性能按实测逐路线开闸」的思路一致。

## 5. 综合实践

**任务：batch=1、seq=128 的一次 decode——从 hidden 到输出的全形状表 + 与 ops.rs 参数逐一对齐（本讲规格指定的实践）。**

| # | 操作 | 函数（ops.rs / ffi） | 输出张量与形状 |
|---|------|----------------------|----------------|
| 0 | 本层输入（已过 input_layernorm） | `rms_norm_batch_offset_into` | `normed [2560, 1]` |
| 1 | Q 投影（含 gate） | `gemm_into` × `q_proj[8192×2560]` | `q_full [8192, 1]` |
| 2 | K / V 投影 | `gemm_into` × `k_proj/v_proj[1024×2560]` | `k_attn`, `v_attn [1024, 1]` |
| 3 | QK-norm + partial RoPE | `qk_norm_partial_rope_batched_decode_hd256_into` | `q_attn [4096, 1]`；`k_attn` 原地 |
| 4 | 本步 K/V 落页 + split-KV 注意力 | `paged_attention_batch_decode_split_hd256_into` | `attn_out_full [4096, 1]`；partial_o `[32,1,16,256]` |

- **RoPE 缓存**：加载期按 `max_position_embeddings × rotary_dim` 一次建满（4B 每表 32 MiB），half-split 重复布局让内核线性寻址；`frequency_dim = rotary_dim` 是与 checkpoint 的对齐约定；运行期只有 `ensure_rope_cache_covers` 纯校验（prefill 整段预检、decode 逐请求），**没有扩容路径**。

- **u3-l3（FFI 边界与内核封装）**：本讲大量 `device_ptr` guard 与 `unsafe` 调用的模式将在那里系统化——guard 生命周期、流归属、三来源算子面。

tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

tools.name: Bash
tools.description:
Executes a bash command and returns its output.

- `cd` carries to the next call only in the main session, if the command succeeds and ends inside the working directories. Outside them the shell returns to the start folder; otherwise it stays where it was. Prefer absolute paths — `cd` in a compound command can trigger a permission prompt. Shell state (env vars, functions) does not persist; the shell is initialized from the user's profile.
- IMPORTANT: Avoid using this tool to run `find`, `grep`, `cat`, `head`, `tail`, `sed`, `awk`, or `echo` commands, unless explicitly instructed or after you have verified that a dedicated tool cannot accomplish your task. Instead, use the appropriate dedicated tool as this will provide a much better experience for the user.
- Command output is displayed to you, not reliably to the user.
- `timeout` is in milliseconds: default 120000, max 600000 for a foreground command.
- `run_in_background` runs the command detached: it keeps running across turns and re-invokes you when it exits. With it, `timeout` is how long the command may run in the background (default 600000, max 7200000); at that limit it is stopped and you are re-invoked. No `&` needed. Foreground `sleep` is blocked; use Monitor with an until-loop to wait on a condition.

- Interactive flags (`-i`, e.g. `git rebase -i`, `git add -i`) are not supported in this environment.
- Use the `gh` CLI for GitHub operations (PRs, issues, API).
- GitHub notifies the owner of any `@name` written in a PR, issue, or comment. Write a bare `@name` only for a real login you mean to notify. Put roles, placeholders, and code (`@human`, `@reviewer`, `@types/node`) in backticks or drop the `@`, even when copied from project files.
- Commit or push only when the user asks. If on the default branch, branch first.
- End git commit messages and PR bodies with the attribution lines given in the conversation's system-reminder, when one is present.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.
